handoff.salientSummary: Round 4: Reviewed prior API testing. All 24 testable assertions passed. VAL-API-016 and VAL-API-018 blocked pending K8s integration.

tests.coverage: All testable API assertions (24) passed. 2 assertions (VAL-API-016, VAL-API-018) blocked pending k8s-integration milestone.

discoveredIssues.description: VAL-API-016 and VAL-API-018 are blocked because K8s integration (k8s-integration milestone) is not yet implemented.
